subject.title: fix(agents): release session write-lock immediately when holder PID is dead

question: Should maintainers consolidate this session-lock fix with the open live-holder reclaim PRs, or ask this contributor to retarget a narrow dead-PID-only hardening PR?
rationale: The PR overlaps multiple open session-lock attempts, does not match the linked issue's alive-holder evidence, and carries unrelated message-delivery changes that already have a separate PR.

options.title: Consolidate session-lock work
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100870, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89673, or a maintainer consolidation as the canonical fix for the live-holder lock issue.

options.title: Retarget this PR narrowly
options.body: Ask the author to drop the metadata commits and change the title, body, tests, and proof so this PR only hardens a proven dead-PID path without closing the live-holder issue.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Leave this PR blocked until the linked issue's canonical fix path is chosen and the unrelated sanitizer commits are removed or superseded.

recommendation.title: Consolidate session-lock work
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100870, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89673, or a maintainer consolidation as the canonical fix for the live-holder lock issue.
